content.title: THE FOOD FIX FOR THAT PROBLEM YOU THOUGHT HAD NO CURE
facts: **Follow along** – for more daily health tips like this.

caption:
Fennel seeds aren't just a breath freshener trick — they contain compounds that relax the smooth muscle lining your gut, which is why chewing a small spoonful after a heavy meal can quiet that tight, bloated feeling within minutes. Pickle juice works differently: it's loaded with sodium and a touch of vinegar that seems to trigger a nerve reflex in your throat and stomach, which can shut down a muscle cramp almost on contact, faster than stretching alone. And pumpkin seeds bring a solid dose of magnesium to the table, a mineral that helps nerves and muscles switch off properly at night instead of firing randomly, which is often what's behind that restless, twitchy leg feeling right as you're trying to fall asleep. Everyone's body is different, so pay attention to what actually settles your own symptoms.
